comments.note: MoviesListViewModel.cs: The WP-012 scope listed only MainContentView.axaml and Program.cs, but OpenFilterManagerCommand was absent from MoviesListViewModel — a compiled-binding reference to a non-existent command would have prevented compilation. Added the command and IFilterManagerService dependency to MoviesListViewModel.cs as the minimal fix required to satisfy AC #4 and #10. Consider updating the plan scope for future similar WPs.

MainContentView.axaml: The ComboBox for filter slots has no placeholder/null item for 'No filter active' state. When ActiveFilterSlot is null the combo appears blank, which could be confusing. Consider adding a null-safe display item (e.g. a placeholder DataTemplate) in a future iteration.

Program.cs: IFilterSlotRepository and IActiveFilterSlotRepository are registered as singletons but IDbConnectionFactory (which DapperFilterSlotRepository depends on) is registered as transient, and ISpdbConfigRepository (used by SpdbConfigActiveFilterSlotRepository) is also transient. This is a captive dependency: a singleton holding a transient. The existing DapperMovieCatalogRepository has the same pattern, so this is an established convention in this codebase rather than a new issue. Noting for awareness.

comments.note: MoviesListViewModel.cs — OpenFilterManagerAsync creates FiltersManagerViewModel via direct instantiation (new FiltersManagerViewModel(_filterSlotRepository)) rather than DI. This is the correct pattern for ephemeral dialog VMs whose lifetime is scoped to a single dialog open/close cycle; DI resolution would grant a transient with the same effect but adds indirection. The approach is consistent with the existing codebase (DatabaseConnectorViewModel is also constructed directly in the ShellViewModel factory). No action required.

[documentation-forward] MoviesListViewModel.LoadFilterSlotsAsync() is a public method that has no call site in the current codebase (intentionally deferred per constraints.md). Its XML summary does not explain that it is designed to be called from a future view Loaded handler in a later M5 WP. Add a <remarks> element to the summary noting the deferred wiring intent so future contributors do not mistake it for dead code.

[documentation-forward] Program.cs — The IFilterManagerService registration block uses the same lazy-owner-factory lambda as IConnectionEditorService, but the comment above only describes the ownerFactory variable, not why the pattern is necessary (Avalonia window doesn't exist at DI container build time). Replicate or reference the comment from the IConnectionEditorService block to make the intent self-documenting for new contributors.
